title: Cognition registry integrity

fix.change: assertion corrected from SessionError::StateHashMismatch to SessionError::InvalidState{reason:"persisted turn number must equal the non-empty turn ledger length"}. Root cause: the test mutates state.turn without extending state.turns or re-signing state_hash, which trips the turn/ledger-length structural invariant (checked in verify_previous_state, session/turn.rs, before the hash check) rather than the hash check itself. The validation code's check ordering is correct by design (structural invariants before trusting the hash); the test's original expectation was wrong, not the code.
